title: The Ice Bridge
text: A bridge of clear ice spans the chasm, thin as glass, creaking in the wind. Frozen inside it are other travellers, dozens of them, caught mid-stride, still walking. Their eyes are open. Some of them are looking up at you.

options.label: Cross quickly, over the frozen faces, and do not look down at them.

outcomes.text: You cross with the frozen faces watching every step. One of them blinks.
The ice cracks under the slowest. A frozen hand reaches up through the crack.

options.label: The slowest goes last, roped, and steps where the others stepped.

outcomes.text: They cross safely, but the cold gets into them and stays.

options.label: The strongest cuts a traveller out of the ice, unable to leave them there.

outcomes.text: The traveller thaws, gasping, and gives thanks with a ring.
The traveller thaws, and is not grateful at all.
